project_type: Python monorepo with core library, CLI (Typer), FastAPI backend, and React/Vite frontend
build_system: pip/pyproject.toml for Python packages, npm/Vite for frontend
test_framework: pytest for Python, vitest for frontend (if tests are added)
build_command: pip install -e . (core+CLI+backend) && cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
verification_instructions: 1) pip install the core package in dev mode, 2) run 'synthid --help' to verify CLI, 3) run pytest, 4) start FastAPI with uvicorn, 5) cd frontend && npm run build to verify React app compiles
setup_instructions: cd /projects/sandbox/reverse-synthid-tool && pip install -e '.[dev]' && cd frontend && npm install
environment_constraints: Network available for package installation. Source reference repo at /projects/sandbox/reverse-SynthID (read-only). Target repo at /projects/sandbox/reverse-synthid-tool. torch/diffusers are heavy deps needed only for V4 full mode.
contribution_requirements: Greenfield project - no existing contribution guidelines. Follow standard Python packaging conventions (pyproject.toml, src layout).
key_patterns: Source repo uses: numpy arrays (HxWx3, uint8 or float64) for images, dataclass results (BypassResult, DetectionResult), SpectralCodebook/SpectralCodebookV4 for codebook loading, cv2 for image I/O. V3 bypass uses SynthIDBypass.bypass_v3(image_rgb, codebook, strength). V4 final uses SynthIDBypassV4.bypass_v4_final(image_rgb, codebook, strength='final'|'nuke', model=...). Detection uses RobustSynthIDExtractor.detect(image_path) or detect_array(image_rgb).
directory_structure: Target structure: /projects/sandbox/reverse-synthid-tool/ with src/synthid_tool/ (core Python package), cli/ (Typer CLI), backend/ (FastAPI), frontend/ (React+Vite), artifacts/ (codebooks copied from source), tests/ (pytest)
